name: variance-report
title: Variance report
description: Actual against a comparison (budget, forecast, prior year) line by line — amount and percent, coloured better or worse, the biggest movers as bars, and an optional comment per line saved in TM1.

settings.heading: The title at the top
settings.subtitle: One line under the title
settings.where: { dimension: member } — the slice (year, period, currency…)
settings.pick: { dimension, under | level | members, label, default } — optional picker, e.g. a region
settings.rows: { dimension, under | level | members, label } — the lines
settings.actual: { label, at: { dimension: member } } — e.g. { label: 'Actual', at: { Version: 'Actual' } }
settings.compare: { label, at: { dimension: member } } — e.g. Target or Prior Year Actual
settings.cost: [members] — lines where lower is better (or costAll: true)
settings.commentary: { label, cube, at: { dimension: member } } — optional comment per line, saved to a text cell (declare the cube in writes)
settings.top: How many lines to show as bars (default 8)
settings.writes: The cube comments are saved to, if any
